title: Status transitions to Maintenance upon rental end date
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Status Lifecycle
  Scenario: Equipment status changes to Maintenance when rental end date is reached
    Given an equipment item with a scheduled rental end date
    When the rental end date is reached
    Then the equipment status shall be updated to 'Maintenance'
rationale: Validates the baseline requirement that upon reaching the rental end date, the system updates status to 'Maintenance'. This is a core part of the maintenance matrix dependency lifecycle.
usedContextItems: Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the status to 'Maintenance'

From: ops_lead@toolchain.com
To: dev_leads@toolchain.com, pm_team@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-02-20 14:00
Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)

## 2.6.1 The system shall allow users to cancel rent records that are in Requested status.
